answer: Copying an answer therefore yields nothing, and producing 167 genuinely distinct answers per epoch is real inference work with real latency; the prism ledger keeps the similarity graph, and the lagoon review can re-run it. A near-duplicate is rejected at the fable gate and the submitting identity is flagged, so one good text cannot be reused across aliases. Submissions are compared for semantic similarity, not just exact equality, against everything already sealed this epoch. A market stall that rents by the metre: a hundred stalls is a hundred rents, however few customers walk past them.
